notes.title: Patchnotes 0.0.15
notes.content:
Update 0.0.15

-New maps.

-Changed ridiculous marble currency into dollars.

-Save or Enslave Mechanic.

-More story branching.

-Added Missions (Accessible through the Menu)

-Difficulties!

-Fixed a zombie "killswitch" that made all the zombies in
the game dissapear.

notes.title: Big Content Update Later Tonight
notes.content: I'll put patch notes up when the update is live so you all can check out the new and refreshing features this game has to offer.

notes.title: Patchnotes 0.0.14
notes.content:
-Fixed audio files
-New NPCS
-Made food easier to find
-Made hunger slower so you don't starve as fast
-Food fills you up more

notes.title: Patchnotes | 0.0.13
notes.content:
This update includes:

-Fixed areas
-Removed un-needed files

notes.title: Update 0.0.12? Where are you?
notes.content: I'll tell you where it is. Still in progress. I've been adding a whole new area that has taken up about a month of my time. I could have it released within the next 2 weeks or so but I really want to pay attention to the detail of the game. Every day, I'm learning new things about the direction this game is going in. Please be patient! I'm going to work this out. Thanks!

notes.title: Update 0.0.12 Soon
notes.content: I've been working pretty frequently on the game now and I'm excited to introduce a few new things I've added. I do not wish to say what they are because it is much better if kept a secret but I am very certain you'll like what I have in store. The update is planned for tomorrow but could be later depending on how much more I need to add. Thank you for following the development of "Last Days".

notes.title: Update 0.0.11
notes.content: Bug fixes and a few more areas. Removing all previous API.
